chunks: Aḥmad narrated from al-Barqī, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:

The last thing upon which I parted from the beloved of my heart was that he said: “O ʿAlī, when you lead the salat (prayer), then perform the salat (prayer) of the weakest of those behind you, and do not appoint a muʾadhdhin who takes a wage for his adhan.”

key_terms.أَذَانِهِ: his adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.أَضْعَفِ: the weakest or least able person
key_terms.صَلَّيْتَ: you performed or led the salat (prayer)
key_terms.فَصَلِّ: then perform or lead the salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام about leading prayer and paying the muʾadhdhin?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys instruction from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding communal salat (prayer) and the adhan. It emphasizes consideration for the weakest worshippers in congregational prayer and discourages appointing a muʾadhdhin who takes payment for calling the adhan.
